checks.observation: The inherited theorem requires hI, notA and notB. The new ProfileAClosed declaration constructs notA from hI; FinalEighty supplies the separately proved notB. Thus the new terminal declaration removes both realizability premises but preserves I(27). The inherited predicates quantify over actual families, not abstract degree tuples.
checks.scope: Inherited versus new proof dependency map

checks.method: Direct web.run access to https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06175v1 and https://a1k.ai/agentic-math/rank-four-sunflower-free-families; inspected the former abstract, Sections 6.3 and 8, and the latter Theorem T8.
checks.observation: The preprint explicitly reports the intersecting maximum 27 and global upper 83, with the 28-row nonexistence problem assigned to exhaustive enumeration. Its stated Lean scope does not convert that enumeration into the local formal antecedent. A1K T8 leaves all three ordinary inputs open, matching the manuscript comparison. This direct check corroborates the frozen primary-source ledger but does not establish exhaustive priority or reproduce the external enumeration.
checks.scope: External mathematical input and comparison baseline

checks.method: Inspected the completed closure summary, portable README, attribution and inherited-source-comparison record; checked the stated accounting and its limitations.
checks.observation: The receipt identifies 161 modules, partitioned into 63 fresh and 98 source-matched earlier rebuilt modules, and retains the same-evaluator/dependency-cache qualification. The portable recipe offers a full source rebuild without claiming it has occurred in another environment. The manuscript accurately describes a stronger local source check rather than independent certification. I have not yet rerun that portable recipe.
checks.scope: Source closure and portability claim calibration

checks.method: Read all committed prior finding summaries and compared the revised first definition paragraph with the numerical corollary and formal intersecting predicate.
checks.observation: f(4,3) is now explicitly maximum sunflower-free cardinality, with forcing threshold f+1. Intersecting means distinct members meet; four-uniformity makes each self-intersection nonempty, so the reflexive formal version is equivalent. This resolves the substantive ambiguity identified by the earlier specialist findings; their authors retain responsibility for formal closure records.

content.summary: The inherited/new/external source map is coherent. I traced the terminal source composition to the inherited literal profile reduction, directly checked the two primary pages, and inspected the new closure and portable-source records. The source-closure improvement supports the stated bounded assurance, while external I(27), complete clean replay, exhaustive priority and cap45 remain accurately outside the local proof claim. The new definitions repair the prior notation ambiguity.
